uncited: - **Inputs:** Current interaction state (active/inactive), timestamp of the last interaction event, target render scale (`userRenderScale`), interaction render scale (`interactionRenderScale`), and interaction hold duration (`INTERACTION_HOLD_MS`).
If interaction is active, update `lastMoveTime` to the current time and apply `interactionRenderScale`.
If interaction is inactive, calculate elapsed time since `lastMoveTime`.
Otherwise, revert the effective render scale to `userRenderScale`.
It addresses the latency issues inherent in high-resolution volume rendering during interactive exploration.
